title: rosa × andegavensis f. germanica
intro: Rosa × andegavensis f. germanica, commonly known as the German rose or Rosa Germanica, is a hybrid of the Rosa gallica and Rosa moschata plant species. This plant is known for its fragrant, double pink flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The German rose is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of the German rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
